_readme: Knowledge scopes recognized by the RAG system (PLAN 10, ADR-0011). This is THE global place to add or remove a recognized scope/tag. To recognize a new integration platform: add an entry below, then label the matching Confluence pages with that exact 'name' (case-insensitive) — nothing else in the codebase needs to change. 'general' must always be present (the app fails fast at startup otherwise).

scopes.name: general
scopes.description: Content that applies to all customers/platforms.

scopes.name: toast
scopes.description: Toast POS integration content. Third-party platform — not this repo's own codename (see ADR-0011).
